name: chrome-bridge
description: Borrow a tab from your own logged-in Chrome and hand it back: navigate, read, fill, audit, diff and record in the browser you already use; logins, 2FA and CAPTCHAs stay with you (handoff). ChromeOS included; the debugger only on request (trusted input, traces, video). Ships the chrome-bridge skill (recipes) and the zero-token CLI.
